## What

<!-- One sentence. What is missing or wrong today? -->

## Why

<!-- What breaks, or what costs time, because this does not exist?
     A concrete situation beats an abstraction: "when I close the till I
     re-type 12 numbers" is better than "reporting is limited". -->

## How I would know it works

<!-- Observable outcomes, not implementations. If this has a rule the code
     must obey, state the rule: "a sale cannot be completed with more units
     than the stock shows". -->

## Scope

- **In:** <!-- the smallest thing that closes this issue -->
- **Out:** <!-- what this explicitly does not cover, so review stays focused -->

## Alternatives considered

<!-- What did you try or reject, and why. "Nothing, this is new" is a valid
     answer. -->
